description: Published prices side by side, cheapest first: model tokens per million, or per unit (1k-requests, 1k-pages, …) for a capability. Use it when a user asks what something costs.

capability.description: Only listings with this capability, e.g. web.search; without unit, the cheapest in every unit it's priced in

category.description: Only listings in this category, e.g. search; works like capability

limit.description: How many rows to return, cheapest first (default 40); the result says how many there are

maxBlended.description: Models only: at most this many dollars blended per million tokens

unit.description: A unit such as 1k-requests or 1k-pages; empty for model tokens

name: get_prices
title: Compare prices
